items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I had Fazola on the clarinet... His name was Verstappen... I used to play Spanish tunes, just to hear that guy play lead on it.

ctx.x: But you had your ten piece band, it was more or less your society orchestra, you would call it... Well I played arrangements. I played arrangements. Then it's arrangements. Yes. And that was at the same...

And it picked up stocks. Yeah. And that was still during the twenties. It was a higher type of a milious set, but I had Fazola on the clarinet, he was great. You know heard of him? His name was... You know heard of Fazola? Yeah, I knew him. His name was Verstappen. That's his real name. That would be hard enough to pronounce. Oh, the greatest clarinet player of the lick.
